basic_profile.bio: A culinary enthusiast and home cook from the Pacific Northwest, I've spent years perfecting the art of cast iron cooking. With a background in environmental science, I have an eye for sustainable practices in the kitchen. My interests include hiking, experimenting with new recipes, and participating in online gaming communities. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings, balancing my time between work as a freelance environmental consultant and enjoying time with my partner and two cats.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of cast iron cookware gathered over years of hands-on experience and active participation in related online communities. My knowledge is also supplemented by my environmental science background, which informs my focus on sustainable living practices.
